title: Compiler Performance Engineer
description:
Falcon is the optimizing just in time (JIT) compiler in Azul Platform Prime. It compiles hot Java bytecode into highly optimized machine code and delivers Java performance that standard JVMs do not reach. Falcon is built on LLVM.

We are looking for a Compiler Performance Engineer to make Falcon generate even faster code. This is not a compiler front end role and not a compiler built from scratch: the compiler exists, runs in production at large enterprises, and your job is to find where the generated code is slower than it should be and fix it in the optimizer and code generator.

You will join a distributed team of compiler experts and work on real workloads with direct, measurable impact on customer performance.

What You Will Do (aka Responsibilities)

• Analyze performance of Java benchmarks and customer workloads, find gaps in generated code and trace them to their root cause in the compiler

• Implement and improve optimizations in Falcon's middle end and back end: inlining, loop optimizations, vectorization, redundancy elimination, speculative optimizations and their interaction with the runtime

• Improve code generation for x86_64 and AArch64

• Write tests and benchmarks that prove the improvement and protect it from regressions

• Contribute changes upstream to LLVM where it makes sense

What You'll Bring (Experience, Skills)

• 2+ years of professional experience in compilers, JIT compilers or low level performance engineering

• Strong C++ design and coding skills

• Solid understanding of compiler optimization theory: SSA, data flow analysis, loop transformations

• Ability to read assembly and reason about why one instruction sequence is faster than another

Very Nice to Have

• Experience with LLVM IR and LLVM optimization passes, or with another optimizing compiler such as HotSpot C2, Graal, GCC or V8

• Experience with profilers such as perf, VTune or async profiler

• Knowledge of x86_64 and/or AArch64 microarchitecture

• Experience with Java, Scala or Kotlin, or with JVM internals

• MSc or PhD in Computer Science with a compiler or performance focus

•

• Working with our CEO and Marketing Director, build a target-account plan of 150 organizations.

In your first year

• Achieve $1.5mm in new business bookings.

Key Requirements

• 7+ years in B2B sales, including 3+ years in new business roles at a digital agency, consultancy or technology services firm.

• Provide engineering support during procurement, construction, commissioning, and field

title: Quality Manager, Software and Regulated AI (m/f/d)
description:
ESQlabs is an innovative, internationally active Contract Research Organization (CRO) and a global leader in the development and application of the Open Systems Pharmacology (OSP) Suite. We combine mechanistic modeling, Physiologically Based Pharmacokinetics (PBPK) and Quantitative Systems Pharmacology (QSP), with software and training to support Model-Informed Drug Development (MIDD) and Next-Generation Risk Assessment (NGRA) for pharmaceutical, chemical, and academic partners worldwide. Our mission is to empower life sciences: helping scientists understand mechanisms of disease and chemical toxicity to optimize individualized, safer, and more efficient treatment and testing strategies.
As a scientific consultancy serving regulated industries, the quality and traceability of our work are central to our value proposition. We are now extending that discipline from documents and reports to software: we are building an automated, AI agent-orchestrated platform for regulated modeling workflows, and we need it to be qualifiable from the first step, rather than validated retrospectively.

About the Role
You build the quality function for a platform that will be certified, not just validated. You own the quality management system, the validation approach for an agent-orchestrated scientific system, the test plan and test reports, and the traceability from requirement to design to test to record. You define the standards; the platform engineers implement them. You report to the CEO, and you start with an interim consultant already in place and a build team that has written its first requirements and glossary.

You Will

• Own the quality management system and lead its certification (ISO 9001 first; information security and AI management standards follow), designed as one integrated system.

• Own validation of the platform under GAMP 5 second edition and computer software assurance: requirements with stable identifiers, test plan, test reports, traceability, supplier assessment.

• Define and govern the boundary for AI: where a language model may draft, where it may never execute, what evidence every automated step must leave behind, and when the system may run without a human in the loop.

• Own the certification framework for our analyses: reference case sets, conformance testing, the certificate register and its lifecycle, hosting of independent audits.

• Run internal audits and corrective actions, advise scientific teams on ICH M15 deliverables, and track AI regulation (EU AI Act, FDA and EMA guidance) into practical requirements.

What You Bring

• A software background: you have shipped code and can read a repository, a test suite and a CI pipeline without translation. This is the single most important requirement.

• Several years of quality management or computerized system validation in a regulated setting (CRO, pharma, biotech, medical software), with working knowledge of GAMP 5, ALCOA+, 21 CFR Part 11 and EU GMP Annex 11.

• Experience taking an organization through at least one certification audit (ISO 9001 or ISO/IEC 27001), from certification body selection to closure of findings.

• A working understanding of how language model agents behave in practice (tool calling, non-determinism, prompt injection) and the ability to explain to an auditor how a system with deterministic and non-deterministic parts is qualified.

• Fluent English, independent working in a remote cross-cultural team, and a pragmatic way with scientists. German and lead auditor or lead implementer training are a plus.

What's in store for you
The dynamic team behind ESQlabs unites people with different backgrounds, spanning disciplines like pharmaceutical sciences, physics, bioinformatics, mathematics, data science, and software engineering. Our trust in each other, our open-mindedness, and our constant quest for excellence and innovation unite us. We value flat hierarchies, where everyone can contribute ideas and expertise to develop the best product

title: Fraud Operations Intern (Practicante de Prevención de Fraude)
description:
Acerca de Sezzle

Con la misión de empoderar financieramente a la próxima generación, Sezzle está revolucionando la experiencia de compra más allá de los pagos, combinando tecnología de vanguardia con planes de pago a cuotas sin intereses que hacen que comprar sea más inteligente y accesible. No solo estamos transformando los pagos; estamos redefiniendo la forma en que las personas descubren, interactúan y compran lo que aman, al tiempo que generamos un impacto real en las ventas de los comercios gracias a mayores conversiones y valores de compra más altos. Mientras seguimos dando forma al futuro de las fintech y el retail, estamos construyendo un equipo innovador, dinámico y apasionado por crear mucho más que una transacción: una experiencia de compra verdaderamente única. Si te emociona romper esquemas en tecnología y ofrecer una experiencia transformadora para consumidores y comercios, ¡únete a Sezzle y ayúdanos a crear el futuro de las compras!

Importante: este rol requiere inglés B2 o superior (escrito y oral). Trabajarás a diario con equipos en Estados Unidos, y gran parte de tu trabajo (herramientas, políticas, casos y reuniones) será en inglés. Si tu nivel de inglés es B1 o inferior, este rol no es para ti en este momento.

Acerca del rol

Como Practicante de Prevención de Fraude, harás parte de nuestro equipo de Shopper Risk Operations, el equipo que mantiene a Sezzle seguro para compradores y comercios. Revisarás actividad marcada por nuestros sistemas de detección de fraude y por Customer Support, decidirás qué es fraude y qué no, y nos ayudarás a detectar nuevos patrones de fraude antes de que se propaguen. Trabajarás junto a analistas, científicos de datos e ingenieros, y verás cómo funciona la prevención de fraude dentro de una fintech de rápido crecimiento que cotiza en bolsa.

Buscamos un/a practicante talentoso/a y motivado/a, que combine un alto coeficiente intelectual con una alta inteligencia emocional. No necesitas experiencia previa en fraude; te capacitaremos. La curiosidad, la atención al detalle y el buen criterio importan más.

Es una práctica remunerada, de tiempo completo y remota: de lunes a viernes, de 9:00 a. m. a 5:30 p. m. hora local.

Lo que harás

• Revisar transacciones y cuentas marcadas por posible fraude o abuso

• Investigar casos con nuestras herramientas y políticas internas, y decidir si bloquearlos o aprobarlos

• Buscar patrones en los datos de cuentas y transacciones

• Compartir tus hallazgos para mejorar nuestras reglas y modelos de detección de fraude

• Gestionar tu cola de casos a tiempo y dejar notas claras

• Ayudar a resolver escalamientos de equipos internos

Lo que aprenderás

• Cómo las fintech detectan y previenen el fraude, desde la revisión manual hasta los modelos de machine learning

• Cómo investigar casos y tomar decisiones con datos

• Cómo trabajan juntos los equipos de riesgo, operaciones, datos e ingeniería

Lo que buscamos

• Inglés B2 o superior (escrito y oral): es indispensable para este rol

• Estudiante universitario/a o recién graduado/a. Ingeniería Industrial o de Sistemas, Economía, Administración, Finanzas, Contaduría, Estadística, Derecho y carreras afines encajan muy bien

• Excelente atención al detalle y buen criterio

• Comodidad trabajando con números y hojas de cálculo (Excel o Google Sheets)

• Comunicación escrita clara

• Capacidad para trabajar de forma autónoma después de la capacitación

• Comodidad usando herramientas de IA como Claude o ChatGPT para potenciar la productividad, la investigación y la comunicación

Deseable

• Cursos o proyectos de análisis de datos (Excel, SQL o similares)

• Interés en fintech, pagos o ciberseguridad

• Tienes estándares implacablemente altos: muchas personas pueden pensar que tus estándares son excesivamente altos. Constantemente subes la vara e impulsas a quienes te rodean a lograr grandes resultados. Te aseguras de que los errores no avancen en la cadena y de que los problemas se solucione

title: Knowledge Systems Manager
description:
VitalSource ®, is hiring a Knowledge Systems Manager to contribute to our Customer Operations team.
Behind every course VitalSource powers sits a large body of operational knowledge: how our products work, how our partners use them, and how our teams solve problems every day. Today that knowledge is extensive, largely accurate, and largely ungoverned.
We are hiring a Knowledge Systems Manager to own the knowledge management practice for Customer Success Operations to change that. You will establish the governance and standards that make knowledge trustworthy, close the coverage gaps that slow case resolution today, and design the knowledge layer our AI tooling depends on, defining how content must be structured for AI-assisted search and retrieval to return accurate answers.
VitalSource is a mission-driven company that delivers affordable, impactful learning to anyone, anywhere.
Key Responsibilities:

• Own the knowledge management roadmap and operating model for Customer Success Operations, including governance structure, domain ownership, review cadence, and content quality standards.

• Achieve and sustain knowledge coverage across support case types, sequencing content development by demand signal and case volume against the seasonal support cycle.

• Structure the knowledge corpus for AI-assisted search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), including the taxonomy, metadata, article standards, and controlled vocabulary required for accurate retrieval.

• Coordinate the design and delivery of AI-assisted tooling for knowledge creation, gap detection, and contextual retrieval, recommending requirements and priorities and supporting rollout.

• Design and operate the quality framework for AI-surfaced knowledge, defining how answer accuracy and grounding in source content are evaluated; routing failures back into content remediation.

• Establish content lifecycle policy and the classification standards that govern which content enters AI retrieval and which may be surfaced externally.

• Apply Knowledge-Centered Service (KCS) practices and build sustainable authoring capacity across Support and Enablement.

• Measure and report knowledge performance, including coverage, retrieval quality, first contact closure, case deflection, and content health, and direct content investment against the results.

title: Client Onboarding & Events Coordinator
description:
Ampa is a pioneering neurotechnology startup developing brain stimulation technology to help eradicate depression . We will improve millions of lives by making this transformative treatment universally accessible. Joining us means you’ll be part of a rapidly growing startup with significant equity opportunities and a major impact on our future.

What to Expect:

Working at Ampa is a rare chance to help transform global mental health and save millions of lives - a level of impact that demands deep commitment. Success here requires resilience, adaptability, and the discipline to put in long hours. If you thrive in a high-intensity, fast-changing environment and want your work to truly matter, you may do the best work of your life here.

Role Overview:
Ampa is hiring a highly organized, detail-obsessed Client Onboarding & Events Coordinator to own the logistics behind two key drivers of growth: getting the Ampa One neuromodulation device into clinics, and positioning Ampa at key conferences and events.

You’ll run the deployments calendar from the first scheduling call through post-go-live follow-up, working with clients, Clinical Deployment Specialists, Manufacturing and our clinical team. You’ll also own our conference and marketing events calendar end to end, from registration and booth logistics to attendee communication and follow-up.

The role requires someone who is very structured, anticipates problems early, and makes sure nothing falls through the cracks. If you love a well-run calendar and a confirmed checklist, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities:

Deployment Scheduling & Logistics

• Own the master deployments calendar across all client accounts.

• Coordinate scheduling between clients, Clinical Deployment Specialists and internal clinical team members.

• Confirm and reconfirm every deployment date, training session and go-live meeting.

• Spot and resolve scheduling conflicts before they escalate.

• Coordinate travel for deployment staff, including flights, lodging and itineraries.

• Create client accounts in the Ampa system ahead of each deployment.

• Guide clients through remote device testing several days before the deployment team arrives.

• Confirm clients have purchased all required accessories before deployment.

• Conduct a remote review of each deployment room to confirm space, furniture and setup meet requirements.

• Make sure every pre-deployment requirement is complete before go-live.

Client Onboarding Coordination

• Serve as the primary logistics contact for clients during onboarding.

• Schedule onboarding calls, training sessions and milestone meetings.

• Send calendar invites, confirmations, reminders and follow-ups.

• Keep organized records of client communications and deployment milestones.

• Make sure clients always know the timeline, what’s expected of them and what happens next.

Conferences & Marketing Events

• Own the annual conference and events calendar in partnership with Marketing and Sales.

• Manage registrations, sponsorship deliverables, booth reservations, deadlines and vendor contracts.

• Coordinate the shipping and arrival of booth materials, device demo units, and swag so everything arrives on time and in working order.

• Build detailed event itineraries, and occasionally coordinate travel and lodging for event attendees.

• Run event communications: pre-event outreach, meeting scheduling with prospects and KOLs, invitations, reminders and post-event follow-up.

• Coordinate on-site events for Ampa staff such as dinners and client get-togethers.

• Track event budgets and log results in HubSpot.

• Run post-event debriefs and turn what we learn into better playbooks for the next one.

• Work with the events organizers to book next year’s booth as soon as possible, usually during the event itself.

• Own the sales leads collection, using the events’ and Ampa’s systems, and make sure the leads end up in HubSpot according to the SOP.

Cross-Functional Alignment

title: Senior Compliance Manager, Derivatives Trade Reporting
description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

 

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

 

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles:  We Before Me , Do the Right Thing , and Get Things Done . These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

OKX is hiring a Senior Compliance Officer to build and run our global derivatives trade and transaction reporting function. The function covers CFTC swap data reporting under Part 45, EU transaction reporting under MiFIR, EU derivatives reporting under EMIR, UK MiFIR and UK EMIR, and ASIC derivative transaction reporting across multiple OKX entities and a growing derivatives product set. These regimes have different scopes, reporting parties, data requirements and destinations. You will determine how they apply to OKX’s activities and help build a reliable process for meeting each obligation.

 

Most of the work is data and judgment: deciding what is reportable, by which entity, and to whom, then making sure the right trade and lifecycle data reaches the right swap data repository, trade repository, or regulator on time and reconciles to our trading records. You will own reporting scoping/eligibility, submission monitoring, and the controls that show our reports are complete, accurate, and timely.

 

This is a hands-on Compliance leadership role. You will work with Trading, Product, Engineering, Data, Legal, local Compliance teams and reporting providers, and you will lead regulatory change in this space. Responsibilities for source data, systems, submissions and remediation will be agreed across those teams; you will lead the compliance framework and stay close enough to the process to identify and proactively resolve problems. You will report to the Head of Markets and Product Compliance and support a central function that owns reporting interpretation, scoping, oversight, and remediation for every entity in scope.

What You’ll Be Doing

•
Interpret and apply derivatives and transaction reporting rules across global regimes, including CFTC Part 45, MiFIR Article 26, EMIR Article 9, UK MiFIR, UK EMIR, and the ASIC Derivative Transaction Rules (Reporting) 2024, exercising independent technical judgment, supported by Legal and outside counsel.

•
Own and maintain entity, product, and transaction-level reporting scoping and eligibility: which entity reports, which products and lifecycle events are in scope, which counterparty role triggers the obligation, and which repository or authority receives the report.

•
Oversee, support, and help maintain the daily reporting process. Monitor submissions against deadlines, including T+1 for MiFIR transaction reports, investigate rejections and breaks, and track each one to resolution.

•
Reconcile reported activity to trading records and repository data, and coordinate corrections and back-reporting with the teams that own the relevant systems and data.

•
Define and maintain the reporting data specification with Engineering and Data, including field-level mapping, reference data such as LEIs, UTIs, UPIs, and ISINs, and the validation rules applied before submission.

•
Build and run the control framework: completeness, accuracy, and timeliness checks, exception management, management information, and records that hold up to regulator and audit review.

•
Drive reporting readiness
